subject: Deferred milestone sweep schedule & VAT nexus checklist (Net60 negotiation)
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Li <samantha.li@orbitalhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-18T09:12:00Z
Subject: Proposed milestone sweep schedule + VAT nexus checklist

Hi Samantha —

Following our call this morning, attaching a concise payment proposal so your finance team can review quickly. High level:

- Scope: pilot + phased rollout (SOW v3 attached).
- Proposed payment schedule (milestone-based):
  • Milestone 1 (Pilot delivery): 40% invoice on delivery, Net60.
  • Milestone 2 (Integration + training): 40% invoice on sign-off, Net60.
  • Milestone 3 (Production handoff): 20% invoice on acceptance, Net60 with 10% retention held and swept 30 days after final acceptance.
- Retention: 10% holdback on final invoice to be released 30 days after final acceptance and completion of punchlist.
- VAT / tax: we need to confirm the invoicing entity and VAT treatment. If Orbital is registered in the UK/EU and provides a valid VAT ID, we can apply reverse-charge on the invoice for technical services. Otherwise, we will invoice with UK VAT (20%).

To keep things moving, can you confirm by EOD: the entity we should invoice (legal name + billing address + VAT/Tax ID) and whether Orbital will be providing POs for milestones? I also included a short checklist Excel for VAT evidence.

Attachments: RWI_Invoice_Milestone1_200k.pdf (stub), RWI_Milestone_SOW_v3.docx, Orbital_VAT_Evidence_Request.xlsx

If finance prefers a Net45 cadence instead of Net60, happy to mark that as a negotiation point — we were aiming for Net60 because of milestone verification windows and internal cashflow alignment, but we can compromise.

Thanks — looking forward to your confirmation.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0124

From: Samantha Li <samantha.li@orbitalhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>; finance@orbitalhealth.com
Date: 2026-11-19T10:04:00Z
Subject: Re: Proposed milestone sweep schedule + VAT nexus checklist

Ben —

Thanks for the clear breakdown. A few points from Orbital Finance:

1) Cashflow: Net60 on all milestones is a stretch for us given board directives — would you consider Net45 for M1 and M2 and Net60 for the final? Alternatively, Net30 on M1 only if a 5% early-pay credit is available.
2) Retention: 10% retention is standard. We can agree to a 30-day release but need a written clause in the SOW around "acceptance" criteria to avoid subjective holds.
3) VAT: We're UK-registered (Orbital Health Ltd). We'll provide VAT ID and a PO for each milestone. We do expect reverse-charge to apply for cross-border services, but our tax team requires:
   - Redwood's invoicing entity legal name and VAT registration or confirmation Redwood is not UK VAT-registered, and
   - A sample invoice format that includes the reverse-charge line and our VAT ID.

I attached our finance contact (finance@orbitalhealth.com) for direct coordination.

Can Marissa (cc'd) advise on whether Redwood can accommodate Net45 on the first two invoices and whether you can offer the 5% early pay credit option?

Regards,
Samantha Li
Head of Partnerships
Orbital Health
Samantha.li@orbitalhealth.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Li <samantha.li@orbitalhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>; Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-20T14:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Proposed milestone sweep schedule + VAT nexus checklist

Samantha —

Appreciate the quick response and the clarity on Orbital's position. Usable next steps and compromise proposal below:

- Payment cadence (compromise):
  • M1: Invoice on delivery, Net45.
  • M2: Invoice on sign-off, Net45.
  • M3: Invoice on acceptance, Net60 with 10% retention released 30 days after completion.
- Early-pay incentive: 5% credit if Orbital pays the full outstanding balance for a milestone within 15 days of invoice (applies per milestone, not cumulative).
- SOW clause: We'll add explicit acceptance criteria and a maximum 5-business-day punchlist remediation window to avoid subjective retention holds.
- VAT: Confirm Redwood entity to invoice as "Redwood Inference, Inc." (UK VAT not registered). That means we'll need your VAT ID for reverse-charge treatment; please fill out the attached Orbital_VAT_Evidence_Request.xlsx and return. Sample invoice format will be provided (we've attached a stub RWI_Invoice_Milestone1_200k.pdf).

I've also created a HubSpot deal note (link below) and prepared a DocuSign envelope for the SOW and amendment — if finance signs the amendment we can lock in the Milestone sweep terms and retention release timeline.

Related links: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/8942 | DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/sign/abc123-invoice-sweep

Marissa / Neha — any red flags from a billing/credit standpoint on offering Net45 for the first two invoices and the 5% early-pay credit?

Thanks,
Ben

Finance sign-off checklist (Marissa):

- Copy of Orbital's VAT registration certificate or a tax authority portal screenshot for reverse-charge verification.
- Purchase orders for M1/M2/M3 before invoicing.
